judgements.justification: A's AC rejected over final ratings 6, 7, 5, 6 with no score moved, calling contributions and writing below the NeurIPS bar.
Neither AC decided by a mean threshold against its own positive view; A's AC stated a negative view and B's cited unanimity.
rPEM's 5 rests on writing, Kinetics, missing related work and incrementality, all central to the contribution, not peripheral.
Both committees read the paper as the same kind of contribution, a new video transform judged on benchmarks.
B's reviewers all had confidence 4, and 1j5f's inferred rise followed a new non-local baseline result, not clarifications alone.
Both committees asked the same things of the paper (clarity, novelty, Kinetics); neither imposed an extra requirement the other ignored.
The wrong claims (1xyW's CUDA, iQAh's Table 2, hB4H's Eq. 5, 1j5f's positional encoding) did not drive praise or a higher score.
rPEM never said the rebuttal resolved its concern; it judged the Kinetics comparison 'not solid' and the writing unchanged.
A's AC did not refuse promised revisions; it judged contributions and writing below the bar, and both forums got the same rebuttal content.
L4t3's 'clear acceptance' sat with an accept 7, and 1j5f's 'vote for 6' matched its edit; B's AC cited ratings, not a stated stance.
No extra or emergency reviewer appears in either committee.
Reviewers in both committees, mostly confidence 4, found the writing unclear; no expert read it as clear.
1j5f's edit came the day it wrote 'leaning towards acceptance'; its text did not argue against acceptance.
No AC set aside a silent detractor; A's only detractor rPEM engaged and its list became A's reasons.
No reviewer in either committee rated above 7, so neither had a champion well above threshold.
No reviewer admitted reading only part of the paper.
No reviewer contested the premise from another theoretical tradition.
B's three-sentence meta-review cited only unanimous positive ratings and an 'excellent' rebuttal, named no strength, and gave no reason for a spotlight over 7/6/7.
Both committees named missing baselines or prior work (rPEM's TRN/TPN/MoViNet, 1j5f's non-local); neither took comparisons at face value alone.
Neither meta-review misstated final positions; A's AC adopted rPEM's list but did not misreport the ratings.
No reviewer or AC raised narrow audience or another venue.
B had no misreading low-scoring detractor; its lowest rating was 1j5f's 6.
Only B's 1j5f asked for a non-local baseline; the new NL w/ R.P.E row (43.2 vs 47.0) met its main concern and its score rose (inferred), while A's version of that row was labelled Involution.
Confidences were 3 to 4 in A and all 4 in B; no lone expert was outweighed by low-confidence reviews.
rPEM's late 2021-08-29 objections stood unanswered, but it kept its 5, so no score changed.
Ratings were close (A 6/7/5/6, B 7/6/7); L4t3's 7 with 'a bit incremental' is a weighting difference, not a markedly different scale.
No reviewer or AC judged the headline claim or title overstated.
Reviewers were confident (mostly 4) and did not converge on flat marginal 6s.
